verdict.rationale: Elicit's export docs cover every format family in the story. Research Reports export as PDF or Word, tables export as CSV and Excel, and the Library and certain source tables export as RIS or BIB for Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote. The pricing page lists RIS, CSV, BIB, PDF and DOCX export. Two caveats: Systematic Review table export is limited to Pro, Scale and Enterprise plans, and only some tables support RIS/BIB. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of exports, and clarity on which tables support RIS/BIB beyond the plan gating.
